text:
maria: Quick check — Brightwell onboarding: are we green for node images and egress fallbacks? plan to start cutover Tue 9am PT. checklist: firewall, image signing, KMS access, airgap validation. @kai, @tomas can you confirm owners?

devon: I think images are baked (sha: abc123). I pushed to the private registry. tag: brightwell-v1.0. see `./scripts/push-image.sh` logs. ops-bot: image-scan passed?

ops-bot: [auto] Image scan for brightwell-v1.0: vulnerabilities: 2 (low). No critical.

kai: I'm the network owner. Firewall rules needed: allow 10.2.0.0/16 -> 52.4.1.0/24 outbound 443, and MDM port 8200 for vault. Will open CR today. ETA EOD.

elaine: Security notes — need HSM/KMS access for customer keys. Are we using customer-managed key in their VPC or Redwood KMS replica? Also need attestation for images.

maria: Brightwell requested customer KMS in their VPC for compliance. @elaine can you list exact IAM/role steps we need?

elaine: Will post a minimal playbook: 1) create IAM role `redwood-ops-vpc-access`, 2) add trust for our deploy account, 3) attach policy `kms-use-only`. I'll drop doc link in #docs after lunch.

tomas: On SRE side — egress fallback: we need a fallback route to our europe-proxy if primary egress is blocked. I can implement route healthcheck + failover. Will need 30m window to test.

sanjay: Brightwell PS is ready to run acceptance tests on staging cluster Wed. They need a list of IPs to whitelist. @kai can you provide once CR merged?

kai: Yep. I will share ip list and firewall CR link: https://internal.crs/1234

devon: quick code-review ping — PR #443 for image rotate script. @maria can you approve config change? small.

maria: on it, will review in 30.

tomas: also flag: air-gapped bootstrap script fails when `--no-internet` is set due to `apt-get update` call in `bootstrap.sh` line 42. Proposed fix: add `--allow-apt=false` flag and preseed package cache. Example patch:
```
if [ "$ALLOW_APT" = "false" ]; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  echo 'Skipping apt-get update for airgap mode'
else
  apt-get update
fi
```

kai: Good catch. We'll need to mirror packages in their repo. Ops: who owns mirroring?

devon: eng-infra owns mirrors. cc @tomas to coordinate.

tomas: I'll sync with infra tomorrow.

elaine: One more: we need audit logging enabled to their Splunk host. @sanjay confirm splunk endpoint?

sanjay: Splunk endpoint: splunk.brightwell.ops:8088. PS team will share certs via secure channel.

maria: summary: owners: network(@kai), sres(@tomas), security(@elaine), infra image mirror (eng-infra). Tasks: firewall CR, KMS role, image mirror, bootstrap patch, splunk certs. Target: Tue 9am PT cutover, staging tests Wed. If any blocker flagged by EOD, callout here. :thumbsup:
